records.name: Load Handling
records.definition: Load Handling is the broad foundation for using physical strength to lift, carry, support, reposition, and control substantial loads. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Heavy Lifting, Carrying Loads, and Team Handling.

records.name: Heavy Lifting
records.definition: Heavy Lifting develops proficiency in raising heavy loads through coordinated whole-body strength and stable lifting mechanics. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Ground Lifting, Awkward Lifting, and Overhead Lifting.

records.name: Ground Lifting
records.definition: Ground Lifting develops proficiency in raising heavy objects from the floor or another low resting position. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Heavy Lifting, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Awkward Lifting
records.definition: Awkward Lifting develops proficiency in lifting loads that are unbalanced, irregular, shifting, or difficult to grip. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Heavy Lifting, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Overhead Lifting
records.definition: Overhead Lifting develops proficiency in raising, placing, and controlling heavy loads above shoulder or head height. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Heavy Lifting, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Carrying Loads
records.definition: Carrying Loads develops proficiency in moving while personally supporting a substantial load. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Hand-Carried Loads, Shouldered Loads, and Pack Loads.

records.name: Hand-Carried Loads
records.definition: Hand-Carried Loads develops proficiency in carrying substantial weight primarily through the hands and arms. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Carrying Loads, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Shouldered Loads
records.definition: Shouldered Loads develops proficiency in carrying heavy or awkward loads supported across the shoulders, upper back, or torso. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Carrying Loads, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Pack Loads
records.definition: Pack Loads develops proficiency in moving with substantial weight secured to the body by packs, frames, or harnesses. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Carrying Loads, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Team Handling
records.definition: Team Handling develops proficiency in moving heavy or cumbersome loads through coordinated effort with other lifters. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Coordinated Lifting, Team Carrying, and Load Repositioning.

records.name: Coordinated Lifting
records.definition: Coordinated Lifting develops proficiency in raising a shared load through synchronized effort by multiple lifters. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Team Handling, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Team Carrying
records.definition: Team Carrying develops proficiency in transporting a load that remains jointly supported by several participants. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Team Handling, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Load Repositioning
records.definition: Load Repositioning develops proficiency in shifting, rotating, tilting, or adjusting a heavy load while it remains under control. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Team Handling, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Explosive Strength
records.definition: Explosive Strength is the broad foundation for producing large amounts of physical force in a short period of time. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Forced Entry, Acceleration, and Heavy Impact Work.

records.name: Forced Entry
records.definition: Forced Entry develops proficiency in overcoming doors, gates, hatches, and comparable barriers through concentrated physical force. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Impact Breaching, Weak-Point Breaching, and Mechanical Forcing.

records.name: Impact Breaching
records.definition: Impact Breaching develops proficiency in opening barriers through direct body-driven or ram-like impact. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Forced Entry, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Weak-Point Breaching
records.definition: Weak-Point Breaching develops proficiency in defeating barriers by applying force to hinges, seams, frames, fasteners, and other weak points. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Forced Entry, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Mechanical Forcing
records.definition: Mechanical Forcing develops proficiency in overpowering stuck, jammed, seized, or partially restrained mechanisms through controlled strength. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Forced Entry, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Acceleration
records.definition: Acceleration develops proficiency in converting leg and whole-body strength into rapid body propulsion. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Sprint Acceleration, Charge Acceleration, and Jump Propulsion.

records.name: Sprint Acceleration
records.definition: Sprint Acceleration develops proficiency in reaching useful running speed quickly from a stop or low-speed start. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Acceleration, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Charge Acceleration
records.definition: Charge Acceleration develops proficiency in driving the body forward with force while preserving balance and structure during a committed advance. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Acceleration, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Jump Propulsion
records.definition: Jump Propulsion develops proficiency in generating the raw takeoff force needed for greater jump height or distance. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Acceleration, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Dexterity-based jumping still governs controlled trajectory, landing, and precision when those are the primary challenge.

records.name: Heavy Impact Work
records.definition: Heavy Impact Work develops proficiency in applying explosive strength through heavy tools or repeated force against objects and materials. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Swinging Impact Tools, Rebound Control, and Driving & Pounding. This governs labor and demolition work, not combat attack proficiency with a weapon.

records.name: Swinging Impact Tools
records.definition: Swinging Impact Tools develops proficiency in delivering controlled high-force blows with sledges, mauls, heavy hammers, picks, and comparable work tools. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Heavy Impact Work, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. This governs tool use for labor or demolition, not combat attack proficiency with an axe, hammer, or other weapon.

records.name: Rebound Control
records.definition: Rebound Control develops proficiency in managing the kickback, bounce, and reactive movement created by the user's own heavy impact work. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Heavy Impact Work, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Driving & Pounding
records.definition: Driving & Pounding develops proficiency in repeatedly applying heavy force to seat, drive, compact, or advance an object. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Heavy Impact Work, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Material Deformation
records.definition: Material Deformation is the broad foundation for bending, twisting, fracturing, splitting, crushing, or otherwise forcing solid material out of its normal shape. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Bending & Twisting, Fracturing & Splitting, and Crushing & Compression.

records.name: Bending & Twisting
records.definition: Bending & Twisting develops proficiency in reshaping rigid objects through sustained leverage, torque, or opposing force. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Bars & Rods, Frames & Joints, and Compact Metal Forms.

records.name: Bars & Rods
records.definition: Bars & Rods develops proficiency in bending, twisting, bowing, or distorting long narrow rigid objects such as bars, rods, pipes, and shafts. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Bending & Twisting, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Frames & Joints
records.definition: Frames & Joints develops proficiency in deforming rigid assemblies at corners, joints, braces, and connected members. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Bending & Twisting, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Compact Metal Forms
records.definition: Compact Metal Forms develops proficiency in bending, folding, twisting, or compressing dense compact metal objects with limited leverage. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Bending & Twisting, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Fracturing & Splitting
records.definition: Fracturing & Splitting develops proficiency in breaking solid material by opening cracks, driving separation, or exploiting stress lines. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Stone & Masonry, Wood & Timber, and Brittle & Composite Materials.

records.name: Stone & Masonry
records.definition: Stone & Masonry develops proficiency in physically cracking, splitting, or breaking stone, brick, concrete, and comparable mineral materials. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Fracturing & Splitting, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Wood & Timber
records.definition: Wood & Timber develops proficiency in splitting, breaking, or forcing apart wooden beams, boards, logs, and structural timber. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Fracturing & Splitting, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Brittle & Composite Materials
records.definition: Brittle & Composite Materials develops proficiency in fracturing ceramics, rigid composites, layered panels, and other brittle or delaminating materials. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Fracturing & Splitting, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Crushing & Compression
records.definition: Crushing & Compression develops proficiency in collapsing, flattening, compacting, or holding objects through sustained inward force. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Containers & Casings, Panels & Shells, and Clamping & Pressing.

records.name: Containers & Casings
records.definition: Containers & Casings develops proficiency in crushing or collapsing crates, housings, canisters, and other hollow containers or casings. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Crushing & Compression, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Panels & Shells
records.definition: Panels & Shells develops proficiency in buckling broad thin surfaces, skins, panels, and curved shells through concentrated or distributed force. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Crushing & Compression, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Clamping & Pressing
records.definition: Clamping & Pressing develops proficiency in holding, compressing, flattening, or immobilizing objects between opposing surfaces. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Crushing & Compression, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It applies to objects and materials and does not replace grappling or restraint skills used against living opponents.

records.name: Object Movement
records.definition: Object Movement is the broad foundation for moving heavy objects while they remain primarily supported by the ground, another surface, or a mechanical contact point. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Pushing, Pulling, and Leveraged Movement.

records.name: Pushing
records.definition: Pushing develops proficiency in moving heavy objects away from the body through sustained forward force. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Sliding Loads, Rolling Loads, and Obstruction Clearing.

records.name: Sliding Loads
records.definition: Sliding Loads develops proficiency in pushing heavy objects across a surface when they move primarily by sliding. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pushing, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Rolling Loads
records.definition: Rolling Loads develops proficiency in starting, guiding, and stopping heavy objects that move on wheels, rollers, cylinders, or rounded surfaces. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pushing, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Obstruction Clearing
records.definition: Obstruction Clearing develops proficiency in using sustained pushing force to move debris, barricades, piled material, and other passage-blocking loads. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pushing, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Pulling
records.definition: Pulling develops proficiency in moving heavy objects toward the body or along a line through sustained drawing force. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Dragging Loads, Towing & Hauling, and Extraction & Recovery.

records.name: Dragging Loads
records.definition: Dragging Loads develops proficiency in pulling heavy objects directly across the ground or another supporting surface. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pulling, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Towing & Hauling
records.definition: Towing & Hauling develops proficiency in moving heavy loads through sustained pull transmitted by rope, chain, harness, handle, or similar connection. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pulling, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Extraction & Recovery
records.definition: Extraction & Recovery develops proficiency in pulling people, equipment, or objects free when they are stuck, embedded, pinned, or bogged down. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pulling, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Leveraged Movement
records.definition: Leveraged Movement develops proficiency in moving heavy objects through leverage, pivots, fulcrums, and controlled changes in balance. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Prying & Levering, Pivoting & Tipping, and Controlled Shifting.

records.name: Prying & Levering
records.definition: Prying & Levering develops proficiency in using bars, tools, edges, or improvised fulcrums to move heavy objects with mechanical advantage. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Leveraged Movement, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Pivoting & Tipping
records.definition: Pivoting & Tipping develops proficiency in rotating a heavy object around an edge, corner, axle, contact point, or temporary fulcrum. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Leveraged Movement, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Controlled Shifting
records.definition: Controlled Shifting develops proficiency in making small deliberate positional changes to heavy objects without fully lifting or transporting them. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Leveraged Movement, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Stability & Bracing
records.definition: Stability & Bracing is the broad foundation for resisting displacement, absorbing external force, and maintaining a strong physical base under stress. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Impact Bracing, Pull Resistance, and Load Stability.

records.name: Impact Bracing
records.definition: Impact Bracing develops proficiency in preparing the body to withstand sudden external force without being knocked out of position. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Backward Force Bracing, Blast & Pressure Bracing, and Force Distribution.

records.name: Backward Force Bracing
records.definition: Backward Force Bracing develops proficiency in resisting strong rearward kick, shove, snap, or reaction force from equipment, machinery, tools, or environmental impacts. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Impact Bracing, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It does not replace the weapon skill used to manage ordinary recoil during an attack.

records.name: Blast & Pressure Bracing
records.definition: Blast & Pressure Bracing develops proficiency in holding position against explosions, shock waves, violent wind, pressure changes, and similar broad forces. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Impact Bracing, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Force Distribution
records.definition: Force Distribution develops proficiency in spreading sudden external loads through the body so no single point absorbs unnecessary force. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Impact Bracing, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Pull Resistance
records.definition: Pull Resistance develops proficiency in remaining anchored when external force tries to drag, yank, or draw the body out of position. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Static Pull Resistance, Sustained Pull Resistance, and Multi-Directional Tension.

records.name: Static Pull Resistance
records.definition: Static Pull Resistance develops proficiency in resisting a strong pull while holding a largely fixed position. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pull Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Sustained Pull Resistance
records.definition: Sustained Pull Resistance develops proficiency in holding against continuing directional tension over time without losing position. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pull Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Multi-Directional Tension
records.definition: Multi-Directional Tension develops proficiency in maintaining stability when strong pulls or loads act from more than one direction. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pull Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Load Stability
records.definition: Load Stability develops proficiency in maintaining a powerful stable base while lifting, holding, pushing, or working under substantial force. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Rotational Stability, Static Stability, and Dynamic Stability. Dexterity-based Balance still governs narrow, unstable, or precision footing when that is the primary challenge.

records.name: Rotational Stability
records.definition: Rotational Stability develops proficiency in resisting or controlling twisting forces while under load. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Load Stability, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Static Stability
records.definition: Static Stability develops proficiency in holding a strong fixed stance while supporting weight or resisting force. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Load Stability, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Dexterity-based Balance still governs narrow or moving footing; Static Stability concerns strength against load and force.

records.name: Dynamic Stability
records.definition: Dynamic Stability develops proficiency in maintaining a strong base while stepping, turning, or repositioning under significant load or resistance. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Load Stability, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Grip Strength
records.definition: Grip Strength is the broad foundation for applying and maintaining force through the hands and fingers. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Compression Grip, Sustained Grip, and Rotational Grip.

records.name: Compression Grip
records.definition: Compression Grip develops proficiency in creating strong closing force between fingers, thumb, palm, or opposing hand surfaces. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Crush Grip, Pinch Grip, and Burst Grip.

records.name: Crush Grip
records.definition: Crush Grip develops proficiency in applying powerful full-hand squeezing force to compress, clamp, or deform a held object. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Compression Grip, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Pinch Grip
records.definition: Pinch Grip develops proficiency in holding or manipulating weight through opposed finger-and-thumb pressure with limited contact area. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Compression Grip, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Burst Grip
records.definition: Burst Grip develops proficiency in producing a brief explosive increase in hand-closing force. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Compression Grip, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Sustained Grip
records.definition: Sustained Grip develops proficiency in maintaining a strong hold for extended periods or through continuing strain. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Hanging Grip, Surface Grip, and Retention Grip.

records.name: Hanging Grip
records.definition: Hanging Grip develops proficiency in supporting body weight or a substantial hanging load through the hands for extended periods. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Sustained Grip, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Dexterity-based Climbing still governs route choice and climbing movement; Hanging Grip represents the strength to keep holding on.

records.name: Surface Grip
records.definition: Surface Grip develops proficiency in maintaining strong hand contact on irregular, rough, sloped, or limited gripping surfaces. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Sustained Grip, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Dexterity-based Climbing still governs climbing technique; Surface Grip represents the strength to maintain difficult hand contact.

records.name: Retention Grip
records.definition: Retention Grip develops proficiency in keeping control of an object when another force tries to pull, twist, strike, or shake it free. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Sustained Grip, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Rotational Grip
records.definition: Rotational Grip develops proficiency in applying or resisting torque through the hands and wrists. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are High-Torque Grip, Tensioning Grip, and Locking Grip.

records.name: High-Torque Grip
records.definition: High-Torque Grip develops proficiency in turning valves, caps, handles, fittings, shafts, and similar objects that strongly resist rotation. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Rotational Grip, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Tensioning Grip
records.definition: Tensioning Grip develops proficiency in applying controlled hand strength to tighten straps, cables, threaded tensioners, clamps, and similar systems. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Rotational Grip, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Fine mechanical calibration remains the domain of the appropriate Dexterity or technical skill.

records.name: Locking Grip
records.definition: Locking Grip develops proficiency in holding a handle, clamp, line, brace, or tensioned object fixed against movement once positioned. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Rotational Grip, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Agile Movement
records.definition: Agile Movement is the foundation for coordinated, responsive movement of the character's own body across changing terrain and situations. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and efficient technique across the broad activities within this field. More specialized Tier 2 branches build on this foundation without making their individual specialties interchangeable.

records.name: Climbing
records.definition: Climbing develops proficiency in controlled ascent and movement on steep, vertical, or otherwise difficult surfaces. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and adaptable technique across this major branch. The Tier 3 families beneath it represent distinct applications of that broader training.

records.name: Natural Climbing
records.definition: Natural Climbing develops proficiency in climbing cliffs, trees, rock faces, and other irregular natural surfaces. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and reliable technique across this family of tasks rather than one isolated maneuver. It remains a specialization within Climbing and does not replace neighboring skill families.

records.name: Overhang Climbing
records.definition: Overhang Climbing develops proficiency in climbing steeply angled, inverted, or overhead surfaces. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and reliable technique across this family of tasks rather than one isolated maneuver. It remains a specialization within Climbing and does not replace neighboring skill families.

records.name: Scrambling
records.definition: Scrambling develops proficiency in moving quickly through steep, loose, broken, or uneven terrain using hands and feet together. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and reliable technique across this family of tasks rather than one isolated maneuver. It remains a specialization within Terrain Traversal and does not replace neighboring skill families.

records.name: Terrain Traversal
records.definition: Terrain Traversal develops proficiency in moving efficiently through cluttered, broken, steep, or obstructed environments. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and adaptable technique across this major branch. The Tier 3 families beneath it represent distinct applications of that broader training.

records.name: Parkour
records.definition: Parkour develops proficiency in continuous movement through built or obstacle-rich environments using vaults, wall use, jumps, and transitions. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and reliable technique across this family of tasks rather than one isolated maneuver. It remains a specialization within Terrain Traversal and does not replace neighboring skill families.

records.name: Jumping
records.definition: Jumping develops proficiency in deliberate leaps across distance or height using controlled takeoff, trajectory, and landing preparation. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and reliable technique across this family of tasks rather than one isolated maneuver. It remains a specialization within Aerial Movement and does not replace neighboring skill families.

records.name: Landing Control
records.definition: Landing Control develops proficiency in ending jumps, drops, and descents in a stable, deliberate position while absorbing force safely. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and reliable technique across this family of tasks rather than one isolated maneuver. It remains a specialization within Balance and does not replace neighboring skill families.

records.name: Evasion
records.definition: Evasion develops proficiency in avoiding immediate physical danger by moving the body out of its path rather than parrying with a weapon. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and adaptable technique across this major branch. The Tier 3 families beneath it represent distinct applications of that broader training.

records.name: Acrobatic Evasion
records.definition: Acrobatic Evasion develops proficiency in using rolls, dives, handsprings, and other committed body movements to clear immediate threats. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and reliable technique across this family of tasks rather than one isolated maneuver. It remains a specialization within Evasion and does not replace neighboring skill families.

records.name: Confined Movement
records.definition: Confined Movement develops proficiency in maneuvering through narrow, crowded, low-clearance, or otherwise restrictive spaces. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and reliable technique across this family of tasks rather than one isolated maneuver. It remains a specialization within Terrain Traversal and does not replace neighboring skill families.

records.name: Tumbling
records.definition: Tumbling develops proficiency in rolls, flips, cartwheels, and other ground-connected acrobatic movement. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and reliable technique across this family of tasks rather than one isolated maneuver. It remains a specialization within Acrobatics and does not replace neighboring skill families.

records.name: Hand to Hand Combat
records.definition: Hand to Hand Combat is the foundation for general fighting through body strikes and physical grappling. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and efficient technique across the broad activities within this field. More specialized Tier 2 branches build on this foundation without making their individual specialties interchangeable.

records.name: Striking Arts
records.definition: Striking Arts develops proficiency in unarmed attacks delivered through controlled punches, kicks, and other body strikes. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and adaptable technique across this major branch. The Tier 3 families beneath it represent distinct applications of that broader training.

records.name: Grappling Arts
records.definition: Grappling Arts develops proficiency in close-contact control through takedowns, throws, holds, pins, and submissions. Training emphasizes repeatable control, sound judgment, and reliable technique across this family of tasks rather than one isolated maneuver.
