records.name: Endurance
records.definition: Endurance is the broad foundation for sustaining physical effort through fatigue, repetition, and prolonged exertion. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Running Endurance, Loaded Endurance, and Conditioning.

records.name: Running Endurance
records.definition: Running Endurance develops proficiency in maintaining useful running performance over time through efficient pace, breathing, and stride. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Road & Track Running, Variable-Pace Running, and Trail Running.

records.name: Road & Track Running
records.definition: Road & Track Running develops proficiency in sustained running on predictable firm routes, tracks, roads, and prepared paths. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Running Endurance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Variable-Pace Running
records.definition: Variable-Pace Running develops proficiency in running that repeatedly shifts between faster and slower effort without losing sustainable pacing. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Running Endurance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Trail Running
records.definition: Trail Running develops proficiency in sustained running across uneven, sloped, loose, or natural terrain. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Running Endurance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Loaded Endurance
records.definition: Loaded Endurance develops proficiency in sustaining physical activity while carrying or wearing substantial weight. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Pack Endurance, Carried-Load Endurance, and Worn-Load Endurance. Strength governs whether the load can be handled effectively; Loaded Endurance governs how long the effort can be sustained.

records.name: Pack Endurance
records.definition: Pack Endurance develops proficiency in sustained travel while carrying a backpack, frame pack, or comparable body-mounted load. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Loaded Endurance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Carried-Load Endurance
records.definition: Carried-Load Endurance develops proficiency in sustained movement while carrying weight in the hands, arms, or against the body. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Loaded Endurance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Worn-Load Endurance
records.definition: Worn-Load Endurance develops proficiency in sustained activity while wearing heavy protective gear, equipment, harnesses, or distributed loads. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Loaded Endurance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Conditioning
records.definition: Conditioning develops proficiency in general physical preparation for repeated or prolonged exertion and recovery between efforts. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Aerobic Capacity, Muscular Endurance, and Exertion Recovery.

records.name: Aerobic Capacity
records.definition: Aerobic Capacity develops proficiency in sustained work that depends primarily on continuous oxygen delivery and cardiovascular capacity. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Conditioning, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Muscular Endurance
records.definition: Muscular Endurance develops proficiency in repeated or sustained muscular effort below maximum strength. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Conditioning, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Exertion Recovery
records.definition: Exertion Recovery develops proficiency in recovering from short periods of intense physical effort so useful activity can resume. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Conditioning, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Swimming
records.definition: Swimming is the broad foundation for moving, functioning, and enduring physical effort in water. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Surface Swimming, Open-Water Swimming, and Diving & Breath Control.

records.name: Surface Swimming
records.definition: Surface Swimming develops proficiency in controlled swimming primarily at or near the water's surface. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Sprint Swimming, Technical Swimming, and Utility Swimming.

records.name: Sprint Swimming
records.definition: Sprint Swimming develops proficiency in short-distance swimming where speed and high output are the primary demands. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Surface Swimming, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Technical Swimming
records.definition: Technical Swimming develops proficiency in efficient use of swimming strokes, turns, starts, body position, and other technical mechanics. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Surface Swimming, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Utility Swimming
records.definition: Utility Swimming develops proficiency in practical surface swimming while assisting others, carrying light equipment, or completing a task. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Surface Swimming, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Strength may govern unusually heavy loads, and Medicine governs medical care; Utility Swimming covers the swimming task itself.

records.name: Open-Water Swimming
records.definition: Open-Water Swimming develops proficiency in sustained swimming in lakes, rivers, oceans, and other uncontrolled bodies of water. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Distance Swimming, Equipment Swimming, and Current & Surf Swimming.

records.name: Distance Swimming
records.definition: Distance Swimming develops proficiency in maintaining swimming performance across long distances or extended time in the water. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Open-Water Swimming, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Equipment Swimming
records.definition: Equipment Swimming develops proficiency in swimming while clothing, protective equipment, packs, or other worn items alter movement. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Open-Water Swimming, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Current & Surf Swimming
records.definition: Current & Surf Swimming develops proficiency in swimming where current, waves, surf, or surge significantly affect movement. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Open-Water Swimming, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Diving & Breath Control
records.definition: Diving & Breath Control develops proficiency in aquatic activity performed while intentionally submerged and unable to breathe normally. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Breath-Hold Diving, Underwater Swimming, and Submersion Endurance.

records.name: Breath-Hold Diving
records.definition: Breath-Hold Diving develops proficiency in intentional breath-hold diving without a continuous external breathing supply. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Diving & Breath Control, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Underwater Swimming
records.definition: Underwater Swimming develops proficiency in moving efficiently while fully submerged. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Diving & Breath Control, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Submersion Endurance
records.definition: Submersion Endurance develops proficiency in tolerating repeated or extended periods of underwater activity and recovering between submersions. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Diving & Breath Control, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It does not grant immunity to drowning, blackout, or oxygen deprivation.

records.name: Biological Resistance
records.definition: Biological Resistance is the broad foundation for constitutional resilience against disease, poisons, venoms, and other harmful biological or chemical exposures. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Disease Resistance, Toxin Resistance, and Exposure Recovery. It represents game-mechanical resilience, not immunity to disease or toxins and not a replacement for treatment.

records.name: Disease Resistance
records.definition: Disease Resistance develops proficiency in resisting infection and maintaining function when exposed to disease-causing organisms. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Viral Illness, Bacterial Illness, and Parasitic & Fungal Illness. It does not grant universal immunity and does not replace appropriate treatment.

records.name: Viral Illness
records.definition: Viral Illness develops proficiency in resisting and recovering from illnesses caused by viruses. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Disease Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It represents broad constitutional resistance rather than immunity to every virus.

records.name: Bacterial Illness
records.definition: Bacterial Illness develops proficiency in resisting and recovering from illnesses and infections caused by bacteria. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Disease Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It represents broad constitutional resistance and does not replace appropriate treatment.

records.name: Parasitic & Fungal Illness
records.definition: Parasitic & Fungal Illness develops proficiency in resisting illnesses caused by parasites, fungi, and other persistent biological organisms. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Disease Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It does not imply universal immunity to parasites or fungal disease.

records.name: Toxin Resistance
records.definition: Toxin Resistance develops proficiency in resisting the immediate harmful effects of poisonous substances that enter the body. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Venoms, Ingested Toxins, and Industrial & Environmental Toxins. It reduces game-mechanical impairment from exposure but does not make a character immune to poison.

records.name: Venoms
records.definition: Venoms develops proficiency in resisting biologically produced toxins delivered through bites, stings, spines, and similar mechanisms. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Toxin Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It does not make a character immune to venom.

records.name: Ingested Toxins
records.definition: Ingested Toxins develops proficiency in resisting harmful substances taken in through food, drink, or deliberate ingestion. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Toxin Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Industrial & Environmental Toxins
records.definition: Industrial & Environmental Toxins develops proficiency in resisting harmful chemicals, metals, solvents, pollutants, and other non-biological toxic exposures. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Toxin Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Atmospheric Tolerance governs functioning while exposed to bad air; this skill governs systemic toxic effects after exposure.

records.name: Exposure Recovery
records.definition: Exposure Recovery develops proficiency in recovering after a harmful biological or chemical exposure has already affected the body. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Acute Detoxification, Organ Clearance, and Chronic Exposure Recovery. It represents natural game-mechanical recovery and does not allow a character to purge any poison on command.

records.name: Acute Detoxification
records.definition: Acute Detoxification develops proficiency in recovering from a recent short-term toxin or poison exposure after the exposure has ended. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Exposure Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It represents recovery after exposure, not voluntary instant detoxification.

records.name: Organ Clearance
records.definition: Organ Clearance develops proficiency in recovering from exposures that place heavy processing demands on the body's normal filtering systems. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Exposure Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It represents constitutional recovery rather than supernatural control of the liver or kidneys.

records.name: Chronic Exposure Recovery
records.definition: Chronic Exposure Recovery develops proficiency in recovering from repeated, prolonged, or accumulated harmful exposure. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Exposure Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Environmental Tolerance
records.definition: Environmental Tolerance is the broad foundation for remaining functional when the surrounding environment places unusual physiological stress on the body. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Thermal Tolerance, Altitude Tolerance, and Atmospheric Tolerance.

records.name: Thermal Tolerance
records.definition: Thermal Tolerance develops proficiency in functioning in unusually hot, cold, or rapidly changing temperatures. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Heat Tolerance, Cold Tolerance, and Temperature-Shift Tolerance.

records.name: Heat Tolerance
records.definition: Heat Tolerance develops proficiency in remaining functional during sustained exposure to high environmental temperatures. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Thermal Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Hydration Regulation may also matter when fluid loss is the primary problem; Heat Tolerance represents the external thermal stress.

records.name: Cold Tolerance
records.definition: Cold Tolerance develops proficiency in remaining functional during sustained exposure to low environmental temperatures. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Thermal Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It does not make a character immune to frostbite, hypothermia, or cold injury.

records.name: Temperature-Shift Tolerance
records.definition: Temperature-Shift Tolerance develops proficiency in adapting to rapid or repeated changes between warmer and colder environments. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Thermal Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Altitude Tolerance
records.definition: Altitude Tolerance develops proficiency in functioning at elevations where reduced atmospheric pressure and oxygen availability create physiological stress. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are High-Altitude Endurance, Acclimatization, and Low-Oxygen Function.

records.name: High-Altitude Endurance
records.definition: High-Altitude Endurance develops proficiency in sustaining physical activity at elevations where thin air increases fatigue. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Altitude Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Acclimatization
records.definition: Acclimatization develops proficiency in adjusting physiologically to a new altitude or comparable environmental pressure over time. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Altitude Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Low-Oxygen Function
records.definition: Low-Oxygen Function develops proficiency in remaining capable during temporary periods of reduced oxygen availability. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Altitude Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Respiratory Regulation governs general breathing efficiency; this skill is specifically about functioning because the environment supplies less usable oxygen.

records.name: Atmospheric Tolerance
records.definition: Atmospheric Tolerance develops proficiency in remaining functional in smoke, dust, irritants, pollution, and other degraded breathing environments. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Smoke & Particulates, Irritant Atmospheres, and Poor-Air Endurance. Biological Resistance applies when an airborne substance causes systemic poisoning; Atmospheric Tolerance represents functioning in degraded air while exposed.

records.name: Smoke & Particulates
records.definition: Smoke & Particulates develops proficiency in functioning in air filled with smoke, dust, ash, sand, or other suspended particles. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Atmospheric Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Irritant Atmospheres
records.definition: Irritant Atmospheres develops proficiency in functioning in air containing strong fumes, vapors, odors, or non-lethal respiratory irritants. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Atmospheric Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Poor-Air Endurance
records.definition: Poor-Air Endurance develops proficiency in sustaining activity in generally degraded, stale, polluted, or otherwise low-quality air. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Atmospheric Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Trauma Tolerance
records.definition: Trauma Tolerance is the broad foundation for remaining functional when injury, pain, shock, or acute physiological stress would normally disrupt action. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Shock Resistance, Pain Tolerance, and Stress Response. Trauma Tolerance governs staying functional during acute trauma; Recovery & Rest governs recovery afterward.

records.name: Shock Resistance
records.definition: Shock Resistance develops proficiency in remaining functional when severe injury or systemic stress threatens circulation, awareness, or basic physical control. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Traumatic Shock, Blood-Loss Shock, and Systemic Shock.

records.name: Traumatic Shock
records.definition: Traumatic Shock develops proficiency in resisting the immediate systemic effects of severe physical trauma. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Shock Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It does not reduce the underlying injury itself.

records.name: Blood-Loss Shock
records.definition: Blood-Loss Shock develops proficiency in remaining functional as significant blood loss begins to impair circulation and consciousness. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Shock Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Wound Stabilization concerns later natural stabilization; Blood-Loss Shock concerns remaining functional while blood loss is actively impairing the character.

records.name: Systemic Shock
records.definition: Systemic Shock develops proficiency in resisting acute physiological collapse caused by severe illness, toxin exposure, allergic response, or other whole-body stress. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Shock Resistance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Pain Tolerance
records.definition: Pain Tolerance develops proficiency in remaining functional while experiencing significant physical pain. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Acute Pain, Sustained Pain, and Exertional Pain. It represents functioning through pain rather than healing or reducing the injury.

records.name: Acute Pain
records.definition: Acute Pain develops proficiency in tolerating sudden intense pain from a recent injury, burn, impact, or comparable event. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pain Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Sustained Pain
records.definition: Sustained Pain develops proficiency in functioning through physical pain that persists over an extended period. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pain Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Exertional Pain
records.definition: Exertional Pain develops proficiency in continuing physical effort when pain is produced or worsened by strain, fatigue, cramping, or repeated use. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Pain Tolerance, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Stress Response
records.definition: Stress Response develops proficiency in controlling and enduring the body's acute fight-or-flight response during danger or extreme exertion. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Adrenaline Control, Surge Endurance, and Post-Surge Recovery. It does not grant supernatural strength or speed; it represents control during the body's ordinary stress response.

records.name: Adrenaline Control
records.definition: Adrenaline Control develops proficiency in remaining coordinated and deliberate while the body is in a strong adrenaline-driven stress response. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Stress Response, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It does not grant a superhuman adrenaline boost; it represents composure and control during the body's natural response.

records.name: Surge Endurance
records.definition: Surge Endurance develops proficiency in remaining functional while a high-arousal stress response continues beyond the first brief surge. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Stress Response, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It represents tolerating an existing stress response, not extending it through supernatural hormonal control.

records.name: Post-Surge Recovery
records.definition: Post-Surge Recovery develops proficiency in recovering after an intense fight-or-flight response subsides. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Stress Response, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Metabolic Control
records.definition: Metabolic Control is the broad foundation for constitutional regulation of breathing, energy use, and fluid balance under changing physical demands. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Respiratory Regulation, Energy Metabolism, and Hydration Regulation.

records.name: Respiratory Regulation
records.definition: Respiratory Regulation develops proficiency in controlling breathing patterns and tolerating respiratory stress during ordinary exertion, recovery, and deliberate breath practice. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Calming Breathing, CO₂ Tolerance, and Oxygen Efficiency.

records.name: Calming Breathing
records.definition: Calming Breathing develops proficiency in using deliberate breathing patterns to reduce unnecessary physiological arousal and restore steady respiration. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Respiratory Regulation, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: CO₂ Tolerance
records.definition: CO₂ Tolerance develops proficiency in tolerating rising carbon dioxide and the discomfort associated with delayed breathing. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Respiratory Regulation, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Oxygen Efficiency
records.definition: Oxygen Efficiency develops proficiency in using available oxygen efficiently during exertion and recovery. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Respiratory Regulation, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Energy Metabolism
records.definition: Energy Metabolism develops proficiency in maintaining physical performance as the body shifts between stored and available fuel sources. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Carbohydrate Utilization, Fat Utilization, and Energy Conservation.

records.name: Carbohydrate Utilization
records.definition: Carbohydrate Utilization develops proficiency in using readily available carbohydrate stores efficiently during moderate-to-high physical output. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Energy Metabolism, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Fat Utilization
records.definition: Fat Utilization develops proficiency in sustaining lower-to-moderate intensity activity through efficient use of slower long-duration energy stores. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Energy Metabolism, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Energy Conservation
records.definition: Energy Conservation develops proficiency in reducing unnecessary metabolic expenditure during prolonged physical activity. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Energy Metabolism, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Hydration Regulation
records.definition: Hydration Regulation develops proficiency in maintaining useful function as fluid and electrolyte balance changes through exertion, heat, illness, or limited water. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Fluid Retention, Electrolyte Balance, and Rehydration Recovery. External heat and cold resistance remain under Environmental Tolerance; Hydration Regulation concerns fluid and electrolyte balance.

records.name: Fluid Retention
records.definition: Fluid Retention develops proficiency in limiting unnecessary loss of body water during extended exertion or environmental stress. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Hydration Regulation, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It does not allow a character to function indefinitely without water.

records.name: Electrolyte Balance
records.definition: Electrolyte Balance develops proficiency in maintaining muscular and neurological function as salts and fluids shift during exertion or sweating. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Hydration Regulation, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Rehydration Recovery
records.definition: Rehydration Recovery develops proficiency in returning toward normal function after dehydration or significant fluid loss once fluids and rest are available. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Hydration Regulation, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It applies once water and rest are available; it does not erase dehydration without replacement fluids.

records.name: Recovery & Rest
records.definition: Recovery & Rest is the broad foundation for the body's natural restoration after exertion, injury, sleep loss, and inflammatory stress. Training builds transferable fundamentals that apply across the whole field rather than one narrow technique. Its major branches are Physical Recovery, Sleep Recovery, and Inflammation Recovery. It represents natural restoration with time, rest, and basic needs rather than instant healing.

records.name: Physical Recovery
records.definition: Physical Recovery develops proficiency in recovering from ordinary wounds, strains, tissue stress, and physical wear after immediate danger has passed. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Wound Stabilization, Tissue Recovery, and Musculoskeletal Recovery. It supports natural recovery and does not replace medical treatment.

records.name: Wound Stabilization
records.definition: Wound Stabilization develops proficiency in the body's natural tendency to slow bleeding and stabilize ordinary wound damage during early recovery. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Physical Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It does not instantly seal serious wounds or replace first aid, surgery, or magical healing.

records.name: Tissue Recovery
records.definition: Tissue Recovery develops proficiency in restoring damaged skin, soft tissue, and minor connective structures over time. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Physical Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. It represents natural healing capacity rather than supernatural regeneration.

records.name: Musculoskeletal Recovery
records.definition: Musculoskeletal Recovery develops proficiency in recovering from muscular, tendon, joint, and ordinary movement-related strain or injury. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Physical Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Sleep Recovery
records.definition: Sleep Recovery develops proficiency in gaining restorative benefit from sleep and adapting when normal sleep timing or duration is disrupted. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Short-Sleep Recovery, Deep-Sleep Recovery, and Circadian Adaptation.

records.name: Short-Sleep Recovery
records.definition: Short-Sleep Recovery develops proficiency in gaining limited restorative benefit when only brief or fragmented periods of sleep are available. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Sleep Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver. Brief sleep cannot fully replace adequate total sleep.

records.name: Deep-Sleep Recovery
records.definition: Deep-Sleep Recovery develops proficiency in obtaining high-quality restorative sleep when adequate sleep time is available. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Sleep Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Circadian Adaptation
records.definition: Circadian Adaptation develops proficiency in adjusting sleep and wake timing after schedule changes, travel, night work, or similar disruptions. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Sleep Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Inflammation Recovery
records.definition: Inflammation Recovery develops proficiency in recovering from swelling, soreness, and systemic inflammatory stress after injury, illness, or exertion. Training focuses on methods that transfer across the branch rather than a single trick or isolated action. Its Tier 3 families are Swelling Control, Exertion Soreness Recovery, and Systemic Inflammation Recovery.

records.name: Swelling Control
records.definition: Swelling Control develops proficiency in recovering function as localized swelling and ordinary fluid buildup resolve after injury or strain. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Inflammation Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Exertion Soreness Recovery
records.definition: Exertion Soreness Recovery develops proficiency in recovering from muscle soreness and low-grade inflammation created by strenuous or unfamiliar activity. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Inflammation Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Systemic Inflammation Recovery
records.definition: Systemic Inflammation Recovery develops proficiency in returning toward normal function after illness or major stress leaves widespread inflammatory fatigue and soreness. Training focuses on repeatable judgment, control, and technique across that family of tasks. It is a Tier 3 specialization within Inflammation Recovery, representing a reusable field of training rather than one isolated maneuver.

records.name: Research & Analysis
records.definition: Research & Analysis is the foundation for locating, evaluating, connecting, and interpreting information from records, data, and physical evidence. Training emphasizes source quality, structured reasoning, and drawing supportable conclusions. Documentary research, data analysis, and forensic investigation are its major branches.

records.name: Documentary Research
records.definition: Documentary Research develops proficiency in locating and interpreting recorded knowledge in archives, libraries, databases, collections, and private records. Training emphasizes navigating information systems, comparing sources, and recognizing material that is relevant, unusual, or incomplete.

records.name: Archives & Catalogs
records.definition: Archives & Catalogs develops proficiency in working within organized collections and record systems to locate material efficiently. It covers catalogs, registries, archives, inventories, finding aids, and imperfect or historical indexing systems.

records.name: Source Comparison
records.definition: Source Comparison develops proficiency in comparing records, accounts, and references to identify agreement, contradiction, omission, provenance, and corroboration. It supports conclusions built from several sources rather than relying on a single document or witness.

records.name: Textual & Historical Research
records.definition: Textual & Historical Research develops proficiency in interpreting old, rare, incomplete, or context-dependent written material. It covers identifying texts, reconstructing historical context, tracing references, and understanding how a document fits its period, culture, or intellectual tradition.

records.name: Data Analysis
records.definition: Data Analysis develops proficiency in extracting useful conclusions from structured or unstructured bodies of information. Training emphasizes organizing data, separating signal from noise, recognizing relationships, and selecting an appropriate analytical approach.

records.name: Pattern Analysis
records.definition: Pattern Analysis develops proficiency in identifying recurring structures, anomalies, correlations, and meaningful relationships within information. It is used to determine whether an apparent pattern is useful evidence, coincidence, or the beginning of a larger trend.

records.name: Quantitative Analysis
records.definition: Quantitative Analysis develops proficiency in working with numerical, statistical, and measured information to answer practical questions. It covers organizing large datasets, comparing quantities, testing relationships, and interpreting numerical results without making data volume itself the skill.

records.name: Forecasting & Trends
records.definition: Forecasting & Trends develops proficiency in using observed patterns and historical information to estimate likely future developments. Training emphasizes trend direction, uncertainty, competing explanations, and recognizing when available data is too weak for a confident projection.

records.name: Forensic Investigation
records.definition: Forensic Investigation develops proficiency in reasoning from physical, documentary, and circumstantial evidence to reconstruct events. Training emphasizes evidence context, trace analysis, contamination awareness, and building conclusions that remain supportable when challenged.

records.name: Evidence Handling & Provenance
records.definition: Evidence Handling & Provenance develops proficiency in preserving the context, origin, custody, and reliability of evidence from discovery through later analysis. It covers documentation, contamination control, source tracing, and recognizing breaks that weaken an evidentiary conclusion.

records.name: Trace Evidence Analysis
records.definition: Trace Evidence Analysis develops proficiency in identifying and interpreting small physical remnants such as fibers, residues, particulates, biological traces, tool marks, and comparable material clues. It focuses on what the trace can support rather than treating every match as conclusive.

records.name: Scene Reconstruction
records.definition: Scene Reconstruction develops proficiency in using physical evidence, spatial relationships, timelines, and known actions to build plausible accounts of what occurred at a location. Training emphasizes sequence, causality, alternative explanations, and separating supported reconstruction from speculation.

records.name: Engineering
records.definition: Engineering is the foundation for applying scientific and mathematical principles to the design, analysis, and improvement of functional systems and structures. Training emphasizes understanding how components interact, predicting performance, and solving practical technical problems. Mechanical, electrical, and structural engineering form the major branches beneath it.

records.name: Mechanical Engineering
records.definition: Mechanical Engineering develops proficiency in designing and analyzing machines, mechanisms, moving assemblies, and systems that transfer force and motion. Training emphasizes mechanical function, motion, efficiency, tolerances, and the interaction of physical components.

records.name: Machines & Mechanisms
records.definition: Machines & Mechanisms develops proficiency in the design and analysis of gears, linkages, transmissions, actuators, bearings, tools, and other mechanisms that convert or transmit force. It covers the functional architecture of machinery rather than the manual skill used to fabricate or operate it.

records.name: Motion & Kinematics
records.definition: Motion & Kinematics develops proficiency in analyzing and designing how mechanical parts move through space and transfer velocity, acceleration, and force. It covers rotational, linear, reciprocating, and linked motion across machines and mechanisms.

records.name: Precision Mechanisms
records.definition: Precision Mechanisms develops proficiency in designing and analyzing small, tightly toleranced, or highly sensitive mechanical systems. It covers clocks, instruments, miniature linkages, fine actuators, and other mechanisms where small errors materially affect function.

records.name: Electrical Engineering
records.definition: Electrical Engineering develops proficiency in designing and analyzing electrical and electronic systems. Training emphasizes circuits, signal behavior, control, power generation and distribution, and diagnosing how electrical subsystems interact.

records.name: Circuits & Electronics
records.definition: Circuits & Electronics develops proficiency in the design and analysis of analog, digital, mixed-signal, and component-level electrical circuits. It covers circuit behavior, component selection, prototyping logic, and diagnosing faults within electronic assemblies.

records.name: Signals & Control Systems
records.definition: Signals & Control Systems develops proficiency in measuring, processing, transmitting, and regulating signals used to monitor or control technical systems. It covers sensors, feedback loops, control logic, communications signaling, and diagnosing signal-path failures.

records.name: Power Systems
records.definition: Power Systems develops proficiency in generation, storage, conversion, regulation, protection, and distribution of electrical power. It covers batteries, generators, grids, converters, power supplies, and other systems where stable energy delivery is the engineering problem.

records.name: Structural Engineering
records.definition: Structural Engineering develops proficiency in designing and analyzing structures that must carry loads safely through materials, joints, supports, and foundations. Training emphasizes load paths, stability, construction systems, and recognizing how structures fail.

records.name: Structural Design & Loads
records.definition: Structural Design & Loads develops proficiency in determining expected forces on structures and selecting forms, supports, and members capable of carrying them. It covers static, dynamic, distributed, concentrated, and environmental loads within a structural design problem.

records.name: Stress & Failure Analysis
records.definition: Stress & Failure Analysis develops proficiency in predicting how structural members and materials deform, fatigue, buckle, fracture, or otherwise fail under load. Training emphasizes identifying critical points, safety margins, and likely failure modes.

records.name: Construction Systems
records.definition: Construction Systems develops proficiency in how structural designs are assembled into complete buildings, bridges, frameworks, fortifications, and comparable constructed systems. It covers modular methods, connections, sequencing, support systems, and the interaction between structural components.

records.name: Computing & Information Systems
records.definition: Computing & Information Systems is the foundation for understanding programmable machines, software, networks, digital information, and synthetic decision systems. Training emphasizes how information is represented, processed, secured, and exchanged. Programming, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence form its major branches.

records.name: Programming & Software
records.definition: Programming & Software develops proficiency in designing, understanding, modifying, and debugging instructions executed by programmable systems. Training emphasizes program structure, algorithms, data flow, maintainability, and integrating software with the systems around it.

records.name: Software Architecture
records.definition: Software Architecture develops proficiency in organizing large software systems into understandable components, interfaces, services, and data flows. It emphasizes maintainability, separation of responsibilities, scalability, and selecting structures appropriate to the problem.

records.name: Algorithms & Optimization
records.definition: Algorithms & Optimization develops proficiency in selecting and improving computational procedures for correctness, efficiency, and resource use. It covers searching, sorting, scheduling, pathfinding, numerical methods, and other reusable approaches to computational problems.

records.name: Systems Integration
records.definition: Systems Integration develops proficiency in making separate programs, devices, protocols, and information services exchange data and operate as a coherent whole. It covers interfaces, compatibility, data transformation, dependency management, and diagnosing integration failures.

records.name: Cybersecurity
records.definition: Cybersecurity develops proficiency in understanding, testing, and protecting digital systems against unauthorized access, manipulation, disruption, and information loss. Training covers vulnerability assessment, offensive security concepts, and layered defensive design.

records.name: Vulnerability Assessment
records.definition: Vulnerability Assessment develops proficiency in identifying weaknesses in software, networks, configurations, devices, and operational practices. Training emphasizes systematic review, threat modeling, prioritizing exposure, and distinguishing a theoretical weakness from an exploitable risk.

records.name: Offensive Security
records.definition: Offensive Security develops proficiency in authorized adversarial testing of digital systems to understand how defenses can fail. It represents the planning and analysis of penetration, exploitation, and access paths as a cybersecurity discipline rather than a single exploit-building trick.

records.name: Defensive Security
records.definition: Defensive Security develops proficiency in designing layered protections that prevent, detect, contain, and recover from digital attacks. It covers access control, monitoring, segmentation, hardening, redundancy, and response-oriented safeguards.

records.name: Artificial Intelligence
records.definition: Artificial Intelligence develops proficiency in designing, analyzing, training, and governing synthetic systems that perform perception, prediction, decision, or adaptive behavior. Training emphasizes model behavior, control, autonomy, and the limits of machine reasoning.

records.name: Cognitive Modeling
records.definition: Cognitive Modeling develops proficiency in representing learning, perception, memory, decision-making, and behavior within artificial systems. It covers model structure, behavioral assumptions, training objectives, and evaluating whether a synthetic mind behaves as intended.

records.name: AI Control Systems
records.definition: AI Control Systems develops proficiency in constraining, directing, supervising, and interfacing with artificial intelligence inside larger systems. It covers command interpretation, permissions, behavioral limits, feedback, operator control, and safe handoff between human and machine authority.

records.name: Autonomous Systems
records.definition: Autonomous Systems develops proficiency in designing and analyzing machines or software capable of acting with limited independent direction. It covers decision loops, mission constraints, navigation or task logic, supervisory control, and managing the risks of unsupervised behavior.

records.name: Medicine
records.definition: Medicine is the foundation for understanding injury, illness, diagnosis, treatment, and the maintenance of health. Training emphasizes anatomy, physiology, clinical reasoning, and selecting appropriate care under the available conditions. Emergency medicine, clinical medicine, and surgery form its major branches.

records.name: Emergency Medicine
records.definition: Emergency Medicine develops proficiency in rapidly assessing and stabilizing acute injury or illness when delay creates immediate risk. Training emphasizes priorities, lifesaving interventions, temporary stabilization, and deciding what requires more advanced care.

records.name: Bleeding & Wound Care
records.definition: Bleeding & Wound Care develops proficiency in controlling hemorrhage and managing traumatic wounds during emergency care. It covers pressure, packing, dressings, wound protection, shock awareness, and recognizing when definitive treatment is required.

records.name: Musculoskeletal Stabilization
records.definition: Musculoskeletal Stabilization develops proficiency in recognizing and temporarily stabilizing fractures, dislocations, severe sprains, and related limb or spinal injuries. Training emphasizes immobilization, safe movement, circulation checks, and preventing additional harm before definitive treatment.

records.name: Triage & Stabilization
records.definition: Triage & Stabilization develops proficiency in prioritizing patients and immediate interventions when time, personnel, or resources are limited. It covers severity assessment, treatment order, repeated reassessment, and keeping patients stable until evacuation or advanced care.

records.name: Clinical Medicine
records.definition: Clinical Medicine develops proficiency in evaluating non-immediate illness and injury through history, examination, testing, and treatment planning. Training emphasizes differential diagnosis, interpretation of clinical findings, and managing conditions that do not require immediate surgery.

records.name: Diagnostic Reasoning
records.definition: Diagnostic Reasoning develops proficiency in forming and refining explanations for a patient's symptoms and signs. Training emphasizes differential diagnosis, probability, contradictory evidence, comorbidity, and recognizing when additional information is needed.

records.name: Laboratory & Instrument Diagnostics
records.definition: Laboratory & Instrument Diagnostics develops proficiency in selecting and interpreting laboratory tests, imaging, monitors, and other diagnostic measurements. It focuses on what a result means in clinical context rather than treating a single test as definitive.

records.name: Pharmacology & Therapeutics
records.definition: Pharmacology & Therapeutics develops proficiency in selecting, dosing, combining, monitoring, and adjusting medicines and other non-surgical treatments. Training emphasizes indications, contraindications, interactions, patient factors, and expected therapeutic effects.

records.name: Surgery
records.definition: Surgery develops proficiency in planning and performing invasive treatment when direct operative intervention is required. Training emphasizes anatomy, operative decision-making, tissue handling, complication control, and the support needed to conduct procedures safely.

records.name: General & Soft-Tissue Surgery
records.definition: General & Soft-Tissue Surgery develops proficiency in operative work involving skin, muscle, organs, vessels, and other soft tissues. It covers access, repair, removal, drainage, closure planning, and management of common operative complications.

records.name: Orthopedic & Reconstructive Surgery
records.definition: Orthopedic & Reconstructive Surgery develops proficiency in operative repair of bones, joints, tendons, major structural injuries, and damaged anatomy requiring reconstruction. Training emphasizes alignment, fixation, restoration of function, and staged repair.

records.name: Surgical Support & Sterility
records.definition: Surgical Support & Sterility develops proficiency in maintaining the controlled environment, instruments, preparation, infection prevention, and procedural support required for safe surgery. It covers sterile technique, surgical setup, instrument management, and contamination control.

records.name: Chemistry
records.definition: Chemistry is the foundation for understanding the composition, properties, reactions, and transformation of substances. Training emphasizes predicting chemical behavior, controlling reactions, and evaluating material composition. Chemical synthesis, chemical analysis, and energetics form its major branches.

records.name: Chemical Synthesis
records.definition: Chemical Synthesis develops proficiency in planning and carrying out reactions that create, modify, combine, or purify chemical substances. Training emphasizes reaction pathways, conditions, yields, purity, and adapting procedures to available materials and equipment.

records.name: Organic Chemistry
records.definition: Organic Chemistry develops proficiency in the structure, reactions, synthesis, and behavior of carbon-based compounds. It covers functional groups, reaction families, solvents, biomolecular chemistry, and the design or modification of organic substances.

records.name: Materials & Polymer Chemistry
records.definition: Materials & Polymer Chemistry develops proficiency in formulating and understanding polymers, resins, adhesives, coatings, elastomers, composites, and other engineered chemical materials. It covers how composition and processing affect physical properties and performance.

records.name: Formulation & Purification
records.definition: Formulation & Purification develops proficiency in combining ingredients into stable usable mixtures and removing unwanted components from chemical products. It covers concentration control, solvents, crystallization, filtration, extraction, blending, and purity management.

records.name: Chemical Analysis
records.definition: Chemical Analysis develops proficiency in identifying substances, measuring composition, determining concentration, and characterizing chemical properties. Training emphasizes selecting an analytical method, preparing samples, interpreting results, and understanding measurement limits.

records.name: Instrumental Analysis
records.definition: Instrumental Analysis develops proficiency in using spectroscopy, electrochemical methods, mass or optical instruments, and comparable analytical technologies to characterize substances. Training emphasizes calibration, sample preparation, signal interpretation, and recognizing instrumental limits.

records.name: Wet Chemistry
records.definition: Wet Chemistry develops proficiency in bench-scale analytical methods based on measured reactions, solutions, color changes, precipitation, extraction, and titration. It covers reliable sample preparation and quantitative or qualitative analysis without depending on advanced instrumentation.

records.name: Separation Science
records.definition: Separation Science develops proficiency in separating mixtures so their components can be identified, purified, or measured. It covers chromatography, extraction, distillation, filtration, electrophoretic or analogous separation methods appropriate to the setting.

records.name: Energetics
records.definition: Energetics develops proficiency in chemical systems where stored energy, rapid reaction, combustion, propulsion, or detonation is central to performance. Training emphasizes energy release, reaction rate, containment, and the safety problems created by energetic materials.

records.name: Fuels & Propellants
records.definition: Fuels & Propellants develops proficiency in formulating and evaluating chemical systems intended to release energy through controlled burning or reaction. It covers solid, liquid, gaseous, and hybrid fuels or propellants, including performance, stability, storage, and compatibility.

records.name: Explosives & Detonations
records.definition: Explosives & Detonations develops proficiency in the chemistry and controlled application of materials designed for rapid energetic release. Training emphasizes explosive behavior, initiation, containment, predictable effects, and safe professional handling rather than improvisational misuse.

records.name: Reactive Material Safety
records.definition: Reactive Material Safety develops proficiency in evaluating and managing chemicals that may ignite, explode, decompose, react violently, or become unstable under heat, shock, pressure, contamination, or time. It covers compatibility, storage, testing, transport, and hazard control.

records.name: Language, Codes & Symbols
records.definition: Language, Codes & Symbols is the foundation for analyzing systems that carry meaning through speech, writing, signs, symbols, and deliberate encoding. Training emphasizes structure, context, interpretation, and how meaning changes across people or cultures. Linguistics, cryptography, and semiotics form its major branches.

records.name: Linguistics
records.definition: Linguistics develops proficiency in analyzing how languages are structured, related, pronounced, learned, and translated. Training emphasizes grammar, sound systems, historical change, language families, and extracting meaning from unfamiliar linguistic material.

records.name: Historical & Comparative Linguistics
records.definition: Historical & Comparative Linguistics develops proficiency in reconstructing older language forms and tracing relationships among languages through shared grammar, vocabulary, sound change, and surviving texts. It covers extinct, archaic, and fragmentary languages as part of a broader field.

records.name: Phonology & Accent
records.definition: Phonology & Accent develops proficiency in the sound systems of languages, including pronunciation, rhythm, stress, accent, and dialect variation. It supports analyzing or reproducing speech patterns without implying perfect impersonation or automatic fluency.

records.name: Translation & Interpretation
records.definition: Translation & Interpretation develops proficiency in carrying meaning between languages in written or spoken form. Training emphasizes context, idiom, technical terminology, ambiguity, and preserving intent when there is no exact one-to-one wording.

records.name: Cryptography
records.definition: Cryptography develops proficiency in creating, analyzing, and understanding systems that protect information by transforming or authenticating it. Training covers cipher design, key management, authentication, and recognizing the assumptions on which secure communication depends.

records.name: Cipher Systems
records.definition: Cipher Systems develops proficiency in the structure and analysis of systems that transform readable information into protected forms and back again. It covers classical, mechanical, digital, and setting-appropriate cipher families without making one specific cipher the entire specialty.

records.name: Key & Authentication Systems
records.definition: Key & Authentication Systems develops proficiency in how cryptographic keys, credentials, challenge-response methods, signatures, and comparable trust mechanisms establish who may read or validate information. It covers key generation, distribution, protection, rotation, and failure of trust systems.

records.name: Steganography
records.definition: Steganography develops proficiency in concealing the existence or location of information inside otherwise ordinary media, objects, signals, or patterns. Training includes recognizing hidden channels, designing them, and evaluating how concealment can be discovered.

records.name: Semiotics & Symbol Systems
records.definition: Semiotics & Symbol Systems develops proficiency in interpreting how signs, symbols, visual marks, gestures, and conventional forms carry meaning. Training emphasizes context, cultural convention, symbolic grammar, and distinguishing literal, coded, ritual, and representational use.

records.name: Semiotic Analysis
records.definition: Semiotic Analysis develops proficiency in examining how signs and symbols create meaning through relationships, convention, placement, contrast, and audience expectation. It is used when the structure of a symbol system matters as much as the individual symbol.

records.name: Cultural Symbolism
records.definition: Cultural Symbolism develops proficiency in interpreting symbols through the beliefs, history, identity, taboos, institutions, and values of the people who use them. It emphasizes cultural context and recognizes that the same symbol may carry different meanings in different societies.

records.name: Symbolic Pattern Analysis
records.definition: Symbolic Pattern Analysis develops proficiency in recognizing repeated structures, arrangements, sequences, and correspondences within symbolic systems. It helps determine when repetition encodes meaning, marks categories, reflects ritual structure, or simply results from decoration or convention.

records.name: Tactical Planning
records.definition: Tactical Planning is the foundation for organizing people, resources, movement, and contingencies to accomplish objectives under changing conditions. Training emphasizes deliberate preparation, prioritization, coordination, and adapting plans when assumptions fail. Operational planning, logistics, and contingency planning form its major branches.

records.name: Operational Planning
records.definition: Operational Planning develops proficiency in turning an objective into a workable sequence of actions with assigned priorities, timing, dependencies, and decision points. Training emphasizes scenario modeling, risk assessment, and keeping effort focused on the objective rather than on isolated actions.

records.name: Scenario Modeling
records.definition: Scenario Modeling develops proficiency in testing a plan against plausible situations before committing to it. Training emphasizes assumptions, likely reactions, environmental variables, alternative branches, and identifying conditions that would require the plan to change.

records.name: Risk & Threat Assessment
records.definition: Risk & Threat Assessment develops proficiency in identifying potential hazards, hostile capabilities, failure points, likelihoods, and consequences before or during planning. It supports prioritizing what must be avoided, mitigated, watched, or accepted.

records.name: Objective Prioritization
records.definition: Objective Prioritization develops proficiency in ranking goals, tasks, threats, and opportunities when they compete for limited time or attention. Training emphasizes mission relevance, dependencies, urgency, cost of delay, and recognizing when priorities must change.

records.name: Logistics
records.definition: Logistics develops proficiency in planning the movement, availability, and sustainment of people, equipment, supplies, and other resources required for an operation. Training emphasizes supply, distribution, resource efficiency, routes, redundancy, and throughput.

records.name: Supply & Distribution
records.definition: Supply & Distribution develops proficiency in obtaining, staging, moving, and delivering consumables, equipment, and essential resources where and when they are needed. It covers supply chains, inventories, distribution nodes, resupply timing, and bottlenecks.

records.name: Resource Optimization
records.definition: Resource Optimization develops proficiency in allocating limited people, time, equipment, capacity, and supplies to achieve the best practical result. Training emphasizes tradeoffs, bottlenecks, reserves, consumption, and avoiding waste without sacrificing critical capability.

records.name: Redundancy & Routing
records.definition: Redundancy & Routing develops proficiency in planning alternate routes, backup sources, reserve capacity, and rerouting options so an operation can continue when a path or resource fails. It emphasizes resilient logistics rather than a single redundant-route trick.

records.name: Contingency Planning
records.definition: Contingency Planning develops proficiency in preparing practical alternatives for foreseeable failures, interruptions, and changes in circumstance. Training emphasizes triggers, fallback states, evacuation or escape, continuity, and adapting responses without rebuilding the entire plan from scratch.

records.name: Fail-Safe Planning
records.definition: Fail-Safe Planning develops proficiency in designing procedures and fallback states that reduce harm when equipment, communications, personnel, or assumptions fail. It covers shutdown conditions, safe defaults, escalation thresholds, redundancy, and recovery priorities.

records.name: Evacuation & Escape Planning
records.definition: Evacuation & Escape Planning develops proficiency in preparing routes, assembly points, extraction methods, timing, and fallback options for leaving a dangerous area. Training emphasizes capacity, chokepoints, route alternatives, mobility constraints, and changing conditions.

records.name: Adaptive Response Planning
records.definition: Adaptive Response Planning develops proficiency in preparing flexible decision rules and branch plans for situations that may change faster than detailed instructions can remain useful. It emphasizes triggers, delegated choices, re-prioritization, and preserving the objective while methods change.

records.name: Innovation
records.definition: Innovation is the foundation for creating, adapting, and improving practical solutions when existing methods are insufficient. Training emphasizes turning ideas into testable forms, working around constraints, and improving systems through deliberate experimentation. Prototyping, improvised engineering, and optimization form its major branches.

records.name: Prototyping
records.definition: Prototyping develops proficiency in turning an idea into a testable representation, model, process, or device so assumptions can be evaluated before full commitment. Training emphasizes speed, learning value, iteration, and choosing a prototype appropriate to the uncertainty being tested.

records.name: Rapid Prototyping
records.definition: Rapid Prototyping develops proficiency in producing quick, limited-fidelity test versions when the main goal is learning fast. It emphasizes short build-test cycles, disposable solutions, and testing the highest-risk assumptions before investing in refinement.

records.name: Proof-of-Concept Testing
records.definition: Proof-of-Concept Testing develops proficiency in designing tests that determine whether the central mechanism or idea can work at all. Training emphasizes isolating the critical claim, defining success criteria, and distinguishing technical feasibility from a finished usable product.

records.name: Iterative Design
records.definition: Iterative Design develops proficiency in improving a solution through repeated cycles of testing, feedback, revision, and retesting. records.name: Improvised Engineering
records.definition: Improvised Engineering develops proficiency in creating or restoring function under severe constraints using available tools, materials, salvage, and unconventional approaches. records.name: Emergency Repair

records.name: Field Adaptation

records.name: Optimization

records.name: Process Optimization

records.name: Resource Efficiency

records.name: Performance Tuning
